sources: Pew Research Center (Sept 2024), Are you in the American middle class? Find out with our income calculator – middle income = size-adjusted household income two-thirds to double the national median; three-person household 2022: about $56,600 to $169,800 (2022 dollars); 2022: lower 28 %, middle 52 %, upper 19 % of US adults (State of the American Middle Class, May 2024).
